# Expand URL

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Expands the given URL.

## Syntax

~~~~text
expandURL(url: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
expandURL(url: "https://jellycuts.com")
~~~~
